_doc: Maiming (systems/maimMarks.js: the body; systems/maiming.js: the deed and what it costs). A person's losses live on person.maimed = { parts: { hand, eye, ear, nose, tongue, foot, brand, geld }, log, taken, aids } — a townsperson on the town's roster, a vassal of the royal court, a child of the House, a pretender, a captured outlaw, the player. acts: what can be done; each count of a part (the first hand, the second) has its own effects: attrs and skills taken from the person's stats (kept in maimed.taken, given back only by an aid's offset), movement (hexes a day lost), battle (share of fighting power lost). flags: blind (no reading, no office, no rule), mute (no speech: the dialog is by signs), noWrite. barsRule: never sits a throne (the heir lists, the crown's claimants, the old line); barsOffice: never sits a council. work: × the work a townsperson puts in at each occupation (systems/townJobs.js weight; under loseTradeBelow they lose the trade and beg). severity: how much the deed weighs on the doer (systems/maiming.js brand). aids: what a town's craftsman makes for the maimed: fits the part, offsets part of its loss, made by one of `makers` (a townsperson of that occupation in town: the fee into their purse), from `material` taken out of the town's market (its cost into the town's purse). Days are game days (120 to a year).

hand.label: Cut off a hand
hand.done: {victim}'s hand comes off at the wrist. You bind the stump with a rag so they will live to show it.
hand.suffer: Your hand is gone at the wrist.

eye.label: Put out an eye
eye.done: You put out {victim}'s eye with the point of the knife.
eye.suffer: An eye is put out. The world goes flat on that side.

ear.label: Crop an ear
look: both ears cropped, the old mark of a cheat
ear.done: You crop {victim}'s ear, the old mark of a cheat. They will wear it in every market.
ear.suffer: An ear is cropped, the old mark of a cheat.

nose.label: Slit the nose
nose.done: You slit {victim}'s nose. By the old law no one so marked may ever sit a throne.
nose.suffer: Your nose is slit. By the old law you may never sit a throne.

tongue.label: Cut out the tongue
tongue.done: You cut out {victim}'s tongue. Whatever they know, they will not say it.
tongue.suffer: Your tongue is cut out. You will speak by signs now, or not at all.

foot.label: Cut off a foot
look: a foot gone at the ankle
foot.done: You take {victim}'s foot off at the ankle. They will never run again.
foot.suffer: Your foot is gone at the ankle.

brand.label: Brand the face
brand.done: You burn a thief's mark into {victim}'s cheek. Every stranger will know it.
brand.suffer: A brand is burned into your cheek.

geld.label: Geld
geld.done: You have {victim} gelded. He will father no sons to press his claim.
geld.suffer: You are gelded. You will father no more children.

eye_patch.name: Eye patch
eye_patch.desc: A leather patch over the empty socket: folk stop staring.

iron_hook.name: Iron hook
iron_hook.desc: A hook strapped to the stump: it holds a shield's grip or a sack's neck.

wooden_leg.name: Wooden leg
wooden_leg.desc: A peg of seasoned ash strapped below the knee: you walk again, badly.

crutch.name: Crutch
crutch.desc: A forked stick under the arm. It gets you down the road, a hand always on it.

false_nose.name: False nose
false_nose.desc: A nose of beaten copper, painted to the skin and tied behind the ears.

rank._doc: × the deed's weight by who the victim is.

brand._doc: What a deed of severity s costs the one who does it (systems/maiming.js brand): karma (karmaPer × s × rank), deeds of character (cruelty, dread per s), the name for cruelty (butcher per s: systems/atrocities.js infamy — a dreaded name opens purses at a siege's terms), reputation in the victim's realm (repPer × s × rank × the culture's stance × lawful), heat with its crown when unlawful (heatPer × s), the court's name for severity (severity per s, capped), lords' memory (a noble victim's realm: lordDeed; any realm for s ≥ heardAt: heardDeed), a rumour (gossip). stance: how the realm's culture takes a mutilation (data/peopleCrimes.json thief.stances: approve/tolerate/condemn) and lawful (the realm's mutilation law allows it, or the crown's justice on a rebel or a convict): × lawfulMult. witnessesCowed: on the street map, those who saw it are frightened of you (threats fold easier). vassalsCowedDays: maiming a vassal cows the rest of the court that many days (× s/3); an innocent lord: grudgeOthers on every other vassal.

player._doc: The player maimed. graveWound: after a wound in a fight of these sources (systems/ailments.js maybeWound), the chance (a hash roll, no shared dice) the blow costs an eye, a hand or a foot for good (pool: weights). vengeance: on the street map, one who beat you senseless with a grudge for one you maimed may take the same from you while you lie there (chance by the grudge). nemesis: an enemy at obsession (hatred ≥ hatred) or a rival House with a feud ≥ feud may have a grown child of yours maimed (once per everyDays per enemy; chance a week).

ai._doc: The world maims too, sparingly (systems/maiming.js processDay, weekly, own hash rolls): a realm whose law takes a thief's hand takes it from a townsperson caught at theft (settlement.npcCrimes, caught, within recordDays) with chance lawHand; a town raided lately (lastRaidedDay within raidDays) may have a resident who lost an eye or a hand to the raiders (raidMaim, once per raid); a succession crisis in an AI realm ends with the loser blinded or his nose slit by the winner (crisisBlind) — the realm's news and the heralds tell it.

law._doc: What each option of the realms' mutilation law (data/laws.json laws.mutilation) takes for which crime (trial charge group / judge crime). repeat: the first conviction is spared (the second takes it). crimeGroups: the judge's crimes (data/trials.json judge.crimes) to the law's groups.

rivals._doc: A rival House's children in your power (systems/rivalCaptives.js). capture: when you beat their retinue on the road (you fell on them, or beat off their ambush), a grown child of the head (minAge+) riding with them may be taken (chance, a hash roll; the heir rides along heirShare of the time); feud on taking. A kept or held rival ward at your court (systems/heirPaths.js) is in your power too. hold: each month held the feud grows (monthlyFeud), the House may get them back (rescueMonthly, a hash roll) and offers a ransom every offerEvery days; while a child is held unmaimed the House dares not plot or waylay you. ransom: what the House pays out of its purse into yours (base, × heir for the heir, at most purseShare of its purse, × barred for one no longer fit to rule); feud. release: let them go for nothing: feud, renown, mercy. maim: the House is a blood enemy (feud set to at least feud; nemesis score), Houses allied to them take it up (allyFeud), the rest are wary (othersFeud) and their enemies glad (enemyFeud); your court's lords think the less of you (courtGrudge); a heir blinded, slit-nosed, tongueless, gelded or handless can never head the House (systems/rivalHouses.js _succeed reads MaimMarks.barsRule) and the House loses renown (renownLoss). The House owes you blood (owedDays): its hired blades come for your children (systems/maiming.js _enemiesWeek, owedWeekly) and its waylaying men take the same from you if they beat you (road.owed). hostage: a rival House that holds a child of yours (heirPaths heldBy.rival) with a feud ≥ feud, after its terms were refused at least minRefused times (or with blood owed), may maim the child (weekly, a hash roll).

seize._doc: Seizing a child of theirs under guest-right (RivalCaptives.seize): their retinue on your hex (an audience, a visit to your town; at your own table if you feasted in this town today and their feud is at most feastMaxFeud). chance = base + 0.6 × your strength (army + stealth × perStealth) / (yours + theirs) + feastBonus, between min and max; one try a day, a hash roll. Taken or not, guest-right is broken: every other House (allies allyFeud, the rest othersFeud, their enemies enemyFeud), karma, deceit and cruelty deeds, perfidy (Atrocities: towns refuse your terms), reputation in every realm (repAll; repHome in theirs), the lords remember, clergy standing (their realm's faith, × 1.5 if it holds the body sacred; and your own creed's), your faith, a nemesis. A failed try costs failShare of it, and feud +failFeud.

death._doc: A captive dies in your keeping (monthly, a hash roll): sickMonthly + despairPerYear × years held (to 5), × maimedMult if maimed, × youngMult under 14; a rescue goes wrong rescueGoneWrong of the time. The House blames you: feud (rescueFeud for a botched rescue), blood owed and a nemesis (not for a rescue).

road._doc: Bandits, outlaws, raiders and pirates who beat you may take something (systems/maiming.js roadMaim, called by player/roadEncounters.js when you are robbed alone or your army is beaten). chance = base[how] × the band's kind (types; unlisted men: other) × its cruelty (a hash of the band, cruelty[0]..cruelty[1]) × (1 + your name for cruelty / butcherNorm + outlaws you hunted down × perBounty + outlaws you maimed × perMaimedOutlaw), at most cap. A thief-hunter's grudge (hunterAt bounties, or any outlaw you maimed) takes a hand; otherwise the pool. A rival House's waylaying men take the same from you that you took from their blood when it is owed (owed), and only rarely otherwise (feudAt+: feudChance). Rare by design: a long life on the roads sees it once, or never.

lines.hunter: "For every one of ours you dragged to the rope." They hold your arm across a stone.
lines.band: They hold you down while the one with the knife decides what to take.
lines.owed: "{house} remembers what you did to {victim}." They take the same.

faith._doc: How faith takes a mutilation (systems/maimFaith.js). The realm's faith (kingdom.religion.faithId) and the creed you keep (your founded religion, by its tenets; or a world faith you adopted: systems/devotion.js creed) each take a stance: sacred (the body is the god's), mild, or harsh (the law's knife is the god's justice). faiths: each world faith's stance. tenets: your founded religion's tenets lean it (sum ≤ −2 sacred, ≥ 2 harsh). stances: rep × the realm's regard lost; heat × the crown's heat; lawful: the lawful deed's weight (instead of brand.lawfulMult); clergy: the realm faith's clergy standing lost per severity (systems/devotion.js standing; × lawfulClergy when lawful); karma, cruelty: × what the deed costs your character when it is your own creed's stance; ownClergy, faithLoss: your own creed's clergy standing and your faith lost per severity; lawStability, lawCost: proclaiming a mutilation law that takes a limb costs that much more stability and × the treasury (systems/laws.js canEnact; a harsh faith's realm grumbles less, never below 0); aiLaw: × the chance the realm's own courts take a thief's hand (systems/maiming.js weekly).

sacred.label: holds the body sacred
sacred.line: The priests of {faith} call it a sin against the body the god made.

mild.label: neither blesses nor curses the knife

harsh.label: holds the law's knife to be the god's justice

muteGreeting: *{name} opens their mouth and only a thick sound comes out. They point at it, then shake their head.*
*{name} has no tongue. They make signs at you, slow and patient.*
blindGreeting: *{name} turns their face toward your voice, the sockets empty.* Who's there?
lookAtYou: *{name} stares at {what} a moment too long.*
lines.verdict: Guilty. By the law of {realm} the court takes {what}. It is done on the scaffold before the town.
